title: Order, Card Dispatch, and Shipment Tracking Policy
content: Order and welcome-kit deliveries follow four standard fulfillment stages: Packed at Warehouse, Dispatched via Courier Partner (such as BlueDart, Delhivery, or Ecom Express), In Transit or Out for Delivery with OTP verification, and Delivered or Cancelled with automatic refund initiation. Callers asking about their specific order, parcel, dispatch delay, or shipment ETA should provide the last 4 digits of their Order ID by voice or keypad so the structured order-lookup tool retrieves live courier and delivery status; no ETA or courier should ever be guessed without tool output.

title: Customer Complaint Registration and Escalation Timeline
content: Every registered service complaint generates a tracking ticket number via SMS (e.g. CMP/0001/26-27). Standard operational complaints are resolved within 3 to 5 working days. If a resolution is delayed past SLA or unsatisfactory, callers may escalate to Level 2 (Principal Nodal Officer) or connect directly with a live human specialist by pressing 9 or requesting an agent.

title: Three-Tier Grievance Redressal Architecture (Level 1, Level 2, Level 3)
content: The bank operates a structured three-tier grievance redressal framework: Level 1 (Frontline): Branch Manager, IVR Voice helpline, and Web Portal, with resolution Turnaround Time (TAT) of 7 working days. Level 2 (Escalation): Principal Nodal Officer (PNO) or Grievance Redressal Officer, with resolution TAT of 14 working days. Level 3 (Regulatory): Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Integrated Ombudsman Scheme if unresolved after 30 days.

title: RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS) Filing and Compensation
content: Under the RBI Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS), customers can file a complaint online at cms.rbi.org.in or by calling the toll-free number 14448 if the bank rejects the complaint, fails to reply within 30 calendar days, or provides an unsatisfactory resolution. The Banking Ombudsman can award compensation up to ₹20 Lakhs for actual loss incurred, and an additional compensation up to ₹1 Lakh for mental harassment, agony, and loss of customer time.

title: Complaint Service Request (SR) Tracking and SMS Notification Protocol
content: Upon logging any complaint or request, a unique alphanumeric Service Request number (e.g. CMP/0025/26-27) is immediately dispatched to the caller's registered mobile number via SMS. Customers can check real-time progress anytime by voice IVR, through the Mobile Banking Support tab, or by sending SMS 'STATUS <SR_NUMBER>' to 567676. Daily status updates are provided until final resolution.

title: Turnaround Times (TAT) for Core Banking Grievance Categories
content: Official resolution Turnaround Times (TAT): Failed ATM cash transaction auto-reversal: T+5 business days; Failed UPI / IMPS fund transfer reconciliation: T+1 business day; Unauthorized debit card electronic transaction claim: 10 to 30 working days; Cheque clearing dispute: 2 business days; Dormant account activation: 24 business hours; Mobile number update: 24 hours.

title: Customer Compensation Policy for Delayed Banking Services
content: Under regulatory guidelines, automatic penalty compensation is credited to customer accounts for service delays beyond standard SLAs: ATM cash withdrawal failure not reversed within T+5 days: ₹100 per day of delay; UPI failure not credited within T+1 day: ₹100 per day; Delayed release of property title deeds beyond 30 days after full loan closure: ₹5,000 per day of delay directly credited to borrower's account.

title: Complaint Resolution Confirmation, Customer Feedback, and Ticket Reopening
content: A complaint ticket is never closed unilaterally by support agents. The customer must confirm resolution via SMS link, OTP, or automated voice survey. If the customer reports that the underlying issue remains unresolved, the ticket can be reopened within 15 calendar days and escalated directly to a supervisory specialist without generating a redundant duplicate ticket.

title: Telecom and Fiber Broadband Fault Repair SLAs and Escalation
content: Fiber broadband outages and faults operate under strict Service Level Agreements: Complete network outage or cut optical fiber line: Resolved within 8 hours; Frequent packet drop or slow speed: Resolved within 24 hours; Static IP configuration or routing issues: Resolved within 4 hours; Router hardware replacement: Free replacement within 12 hours.

title: E-Commerce Damaged, Defective, or Missing Shipment Claims
content: Customers receiving a damaged parcel, tampered seal, or missing item must report the discrepancy within 48 hours of delivery. An unboxing photo or video may be requested for high-value items. Free reverse pickup is arranged within 2 business days, and a replacement dispatch or 100% refund is initiated within 24 hours of courier pickup.

title: Senior Citizens and Specially Abled Grievance Priority Handling
content: Grievance tickets filed by senior citizens (aged 60+) and differently-abled customers are automatically tagged with Priority Status in the CRM queue. These tickets bypass standard tiers and are routed directly to dedicated relationship managers, with an accelerated resolution target of 48 business hours and doorstep visit assistance if required.

title: Right to Appeal and Independent Executive Audit Protocol
content: If a customer believes that frontline staff failed to handle their grievance impartially or followed arbitrary policies, they have the right to request an Independent Executive Audit. The case file, including voice recordings, SMS logs, and backend timestamps, is reviewed by an independent Internal Ombudsman committee within 10 working days.
